maya-people-ops: Heads up: new hire Liu (start Mon 3/30) needs EAD & passport overnighted to us for I-9. Can we arrange courier pickup tomorrow AM? Details below.
recruiter_kate: Thanks Maya. Liu says passport scan + original EAD arriving tomorrow morning from spouse. I'll confirm pickup window.
newhire_liu: Hi all — I can drop at FedEx 24hr tomorrow 8am if needed. Prefer courier pick-up from my apartment though (ZIP 94110).
maya-people-ops: Drop is OK but prefer pick-up to avoid delay. We'll cover cost. Need signature required + insurance for loss >$500. Courier team: @ops-mailroom can you book?
ops-mailroom: I can book FedEx Priority Overnight with signature. Need: full name, phone, address, declared value. Also confirm customs form? (domestic -> no).
recruiter_kate: Name: Liu, Wei. Phone: +1-415-555-0199. Addr: 221 Valencia St, Apt 3B, SF 94110. Declared value: $1000 (just to be safe).
maya-people-ops: Perfect. Please mark package description as 'personal id docs - HR' so customs doesn't get weird. Also include a signed copy of offer letter inside.
ops-mailroom: Booked. Confirmation #FDX123456789. Pickup window 10:00–12:00 tomorrow. Tracking: `https://fedex.com/track/FDX123456789`
legal_bot: Reminder: do not include SSN on outside label or in email. For I-9, we need to inspect original documents in-person — plan: HR will do remote verification + in-office inspection on first day per policy 4.3.3.
ben-engineering: Quick Q: if package is delayed and Liu can't produce docs Day 1, can they start remotely? Need to confirm with hiring manager.
maya-people-ops: Yes, conditional remote start is OK for onboarding (payroll/benefits delayed until docs complete). I'll send contingency note to manager @ben-engineering.
ben-engineering: :thumbsup: thanks — please cc me on the note.
recruiter_kate: I've told Liu to be at door 9:30 so courier can pick up early. I'll update with pick-up confirmation and send proof of shipment.
maya-people-ops: Thanks. Once tracking shows 'picked up', I'll create a benefits hold for Liu until docs verified. Also will prefill their I-9 Section 2 checklist.
ops-mailroom: Picked up at 10:18. Tracking shows 'In transit'.
newhire_liu: Got it — thanks everyone. Will DM if any hiccups.
